TDocOptionsBase.GetFontWidth.text: The width of a font's characters in design units, or 0 when the font uses its natural width.

TDrawText.PrepareResize.text: Called when this text becomes the one selected object: notes the length of its box and the width of its font (SetScalingWidths), which is what resizing it with its handles works from.

TDrawText.CanResize.text: Yes: a text has the eight handles of the tracker when it is the one selected object (a label has none on its middle).

TDrawLabel.PrepareResize.text: Called when this label becomes the one selected object: notes the length of its box and the width of its font (SetScalingWidths), which is what resizing it with its handles works from.

TDrawLabel.CanResize.text: Yes: a label has the eight handles of the tracker when it is the one selected object (a label has none on its middle).
